d:
I am doing a little change to the structure of the sets. There are several users who messaged me over time saying it would be nice to view the full set in one go rather than separately viewing an extra folder, so I'm going to try this format out for the next couple of sets, see how it goes, and either continue or switch back based on the response.

Love Support Tier gets access to a specific set of images while Plus Love Support Tier users get access to the full set + the group sex is now separated to a separate zip file with tag '-gb' so that can be downloaded by the ones who only like it. Same goes for a pregnant version if a pregnant version exists.

This will help me during story sets too, since I can do the full story in one go instead of creating an extras set. And sometimes a group sex version doesn't match with the story, so a separate folder for that helps.
